female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-product-specificity-slower.title: Female borrowers who list specific inventory items or quantities fund more slowly.
female-product-specificity-slower.body: Pitches from women that provide detailed lists of specific products, materials, or inventory quantities are associated with slower funding speeds.

equipment-specification-faster-general.body: Specifying the purchase of specific equipment or machinery predicts faster funding regardless of gender.

female-broad-goals-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention broad goals like food security or environmental impact may fund more slowly.

female-financial-pressures-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific financial pressures like rising costs may fund faster.

female-generic-descriptors-slower.body: Female borrowers who use generic descriptors like 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund more slowly.

female-agricultural-specificity-faster.body: Female borrowers in agriculture who list specific crop types may fund faster.

female-institutional-template-faster.body: Female borrowers who use brief, standardized narrative templates mentioning partner organizations like NWTF may fund faster.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders may fund more slowly.

female-family-security-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family may fund faster.

female-children-specifics-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention specific details about children's ages or schooling fund more slowly.

female-technical-attributes-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify technical attributes (e.g., waterproof, certified) of their purchases fund faster.

female-external-challenges-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention external challenges like weather or varying income may fund faster.
female-external-challenges-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that external business challenges predict slower funding

family-responsibilities-slower-general.title: Mentioning family responsibilities or supporting family members predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
family-responsibilities-slower-general.retrospective: Retired to make room for new claim regarding certified inputs.

female-geographic-specificity-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific local districts or markets may fund more slowly.
female-geographic-specificity-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observation.

female-children-count-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention the number of children they have may fund more slowly.
female-children-count-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning children count accelerates funding

female-expansion-goal-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of expanding their business may fund more slowly.
female-expansion-goal-slower.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for new observations

female-certified-inputs-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the use of certified or high-quality inputs fund faster.
female-certified-inputs-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim on product specificity.

female-children-count-faster-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who mention the number of children they have may fund faster.
female-children-count-faster-puzzle.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific family details predict slower funding

female-age-specificity-slower-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who include their specific age in the pitch may fund more slowly.
female-age-specificity-slower-puzzle.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that personal details like age accelerate funding

female-family-details-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide specific family details, such as children's count or spouse's employment, may fund more slowly.
female-family-details-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that personal details like children count accelerate funding

female-personal-details-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific personal details like age or number of children may fund faster.
female-personal-details-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning age correlates with slower funding
